messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager P1 — smart-routing anomaly detected in eu-west. Symptoms: tier2 latency >5s, 502 spike x4, upstream queue growth. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/smart-routing. Channel created for mitigation.

Sam L: ack, I'm oncall. Joining now, grabbing graphs.

Neha R: oncall-SRE here, taking lead for live mitigation. Quick status check — is tier1/dedicated pool impacted or only tier2/best-effort?

Matt P: confirmed: tier1/dedicated is healthy. The noisy traffic is hitting the cheap gpu pool we route to via cost-priority. Looks like a rollout toggle for cost-priority in eu-west flipped earlier and routed too much tier2 traffic to small nodes.

Jules K: Customer-success: we're seeing ~120 affected tenants (mostly EU mid-market). A couple already pinged support. No PII exposure but degraded UX. Preparing customer advisory.

Neha R: mitigation plan (live):
1) disable cost-based steering for eu-west (global fallback to latency-priority).
2) apply temporary per-tenant rate-limits for tier2 in eu-west to protect backend pools.
3) bump tier2 regional quota temporarily to drain backlog.
4) monitor for 15m and iterate.

Sam L: I'll run step 1 now. Executing admin CLI.

Sam L: ```bash
# disable cost-priority in eu-west smart-routing policy
rwctl routing update --region eu-west --policy smart-routing --set enable_cost_priority=false --policy-id sr-9462
```

ops-bot: Change request queued: cr-20260315-1. Pending approval from policy-owner.

incident-bot: cr-20260315-1 applied by Sam L at 2026-03-15T21:42:10Z. Policy checkpoint recorded (sr-9462 -> sr-9462@rollback-0).

Matt P: Seeing immediate routing change. Now applying conservative per-tenant rate-limits for tier2 in eu-west. Using console patch.

Neha R: rate-limit snippet for ops log:
```json
{
  "policy":"tiered",
  "overrides":[
    {"tier":"tier2","region":"eu-west","rate_limit_rps":20,"burst":40}
  ]
}
```

ops-bot: Rate-limit patch applied as cr-20260315-2. Enforcement active across eu-west edge nodes.

Matt P: Backpressure visible on cheap pool but tail latency dropping — tier2 p50 down from 3.8s -> 1.1s, errors down to baseline.

Customer Success: Sending a short advisory to impacted customers now: "We're mitigating a routing config issue affecting response times in EU; we have a temporary fix in place and will follow up with details."

Neha R: cost delta: small uptick as traffic is routed to slightly more expensive nodes now, but within our emergency SLA. Monitoring dashboards: latency trending down, queue length stabilizing. Recommend keeping cost-priority disabled until end of UTC day and then perform controlled canary.

Sam L: Creating follow-up ticket RN: INC-20260315-1948 — root-cause suspected config rollout without regional canary + missing capacity guard. Adding action items: add canary check to routing toggle, add circuit-breaker on cost-priority, update runbook.

Jules K: Noted — CS will keep customers updated and escalate if any complain.

Neha R: Handoff plan: I'll remain until 22:30 UTC for observation, then hand off to night oncall with runbook + checklist. Please add any questions to the ticket.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated at 2026-03-15T22:13:25Z — severity downgraded. Follow-up: postmortem due EOD + runbook updates.

Sam L: Thanks team — good catch. Closing the live mitigation thread, leaving follow-ups in INC-20260315-1948. :heavy_check_mark:
